description: A link that makes whoever opens it the owner of a site nobody owns yet, after saving a passkey. Works once, for two weeks. Give it to the person who should own the site, never post it. Once the site has an owner, they invite others from its settings.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: invite_link
title: Invite link
